extracted.intended_audience: IMLS program staff, museum administrators, grant evaluators, and policy/research analysts
extracted.subtask_description: An evaluation-report level listing of the metrics, categories, and cross-tabulations used to describe and analyze museum grant applications and projects under the IMLS Museums for America (MFA) program (2004–2010 categories). Includes project activity types, award outcomes, museum characteristics, and award amounts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Museum Discipline
rubrics_metrics.description: Categorization of museums by discipline (General/Specialized/Other Museums; Nature Centers; Natural History/Anthropology; Science/Technology Museums; Children’s/Youth Museums; Arboretum/Botanic Gardens; Aquarium/Zoos; Historic Sites/History/Historic Societies; Art Museums).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as number and percent of applications/projects within each MFA grant category and cross-tabulated by region, museum size, and award amount. Tables include counts (n=) and %; many tables note '* Statistically significant p≤.05'.

rubrics_metrics.name: Region
rubrics_metrics.description: Geographic region of the museum (West; Mountain Plains; Mid-West; South East; Mid-Atlantic; New England).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used as a stratification variable; reported as number and percent of applications/projects within MFA grant categories and activity-area cross-tabs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Museum Size
rubrics_metrics.description: Size class of the museum (Small; Medium; Large).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to cross-tabulate counts/percents of applications, project types, and award amounts; reported for primary focus groups (e.g., Programming as Primary Focus by museum size and award amount).

rubrics_metrics.name: MFA Grant Category (2004–2007)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant category labels used in 2004–2007: 'Serving as Centers of Community Engagement', 'Supporting Lifelong Learning', 'Sustaining Cultural Heritage'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications and award status are reported within these categories (No/Yes).

rubrics_metrics.name: MFA Grant Category (2008–2010)
rubrics_metrics.description: Grant category labels used in 2008–2010: 'Building Institutional Capacity', 'Collections Stewardship', 'Engaging Communities'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications, award status, and project characteristics are reported within these newer categories.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application Attempt Number
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of times the institution applied for the MFA grant (1, 2, or 3).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Cross-tabulated with funding status (No/Yes) to show award rates by attempt number.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Status
rubrics_metrics.description: Whether the application received funding (Yes) or not (No).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as counts and percentages by grant category, attempt number, discipline, size, region, and primary activity focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Award Amount Category
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to report distribution of awards across project types and museum sizes (counts and percents).

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Activity Area (high-level)
rubrics_metrics.description: Primary activity area of the project: Technology/Online Resources; Organizational Development; Programming; Exhibitions; Digitization/Collections; Resources Development.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each project is classified by a primary area, and tables report number and percent of projects by primary area across discipline, region, size, and award amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Primary Focus (Programming / Exhibitions / Technology / Digitization/Collections)
rubrics_metrics.description: Indicator whether a project has Programming, Exhibitions, Technology, or Digitization/Collections as the primary focus.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Separate tables show projects 'with X as the Primary Focus' and cross-tab how many of those projects also conducted other activity types; counts and percents presented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Activities (educational subtypes)
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific educational programming activities conducted for the project: 'Education programs at our institution', 'In-school programs', 'Afterschool programs', 'Curriculum guides', 'Classes or institutes', 'Training sessions', 'Conferences', 'Internships, mentoring or apprenticeships opportunities'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each activity is a Yes/No variable reported as number and percent of projects conducting that activity (e.g., 96% Yes for 'Education programs at our institution' in Programming primary-focus projects).

rubrics_metrics.name: Program Activities (general/live/interpretive subtypes)
rubrics_metrics.description: General and live programming activity types: 'Demonstrations and workshops', 'Lectures', 'Community discussion groups', 'Interpretive programs or materials', 'Live performances', 'Broadcasts'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No counts and percents for projects (often within Programming or Exhibitions primary-focus tables).

rubrics_metrics.name: Exhibitions Activity Types
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific exhibitions activities: 'Develop concept for new exhibit', 'Research new exhibit', 'Plan new exhibit', 'Fabricate a new exhibit', 'Upgrade/expanded current exhibit, including making current exhibit accessible', 'Create traveling exhibit', 'Produced brochure/product/materials', 'Incorporated interactive piece into an exhibit', 'Imported exhibit materials'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each is reported as a Yes/No variable with counts and percents among projects (overall and within 'Exhibitions as Primary Focus').

rubrics_metrics.name: Technology Activity Types
rubrics_metrics.description: Specific technology/media activities: 'Development of media-based products', 'Update or create new website', 'Create audio tour', 'Create online exhibition', 'Develop high-tech interactive exhibition', 'Purchase technology equipment', 'Upgrade/purchase/install new software', 'Create online access to collections records or information', 'Consolidate multiple databases', 'Develop searchable online database', 'Produce video/CD/product', 'Produce tech application'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each activity recorded as Yes/No with counts and percents; tables also show these when Technology is the primary focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Digitization Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Digitization activities conducted for the project: 'Digitize collections', 'Convert non-digital content to digital content', 'Repurpose digital content', 'Create new digital content'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No counts and percents; also used to define 'Digitization/Collections' primary focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Extent of Collections Digitized
rubrics_metrics.description: Portion of the collections covered by digitization projects: 'Less than 10% of collection', '20%-50%', 'Over 50% of the collection'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to describe scope of digitization within projects; reported as counts and percents among digitizing projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Collections Activities (non-digitization)
rubrics_metrics.description: Collections-related activities: 'Inventory collections', 'Move collections', 'Create public collections finding guides', 'Create new collections management guidelines or procedures', 'Implement new collections management system'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Each recorded as Yes/No and reported as counts/percents overall and when Collections/Digitization is the primary focus.

rubrics_metrics.name: Staffing & Contracting Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Staffing and contracting activities conducted for projects: 'Provide staff, volunteer and/or docent training (including in use of new technology and online resources)', 'Hire full-time staff', 'Hire part-time staff', 'Hire a consultant', 'Contract for services (fabrication, design, security, etc.)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No counts and percents in primary-focus tables (Programming/Exhibitions/Technology/Digitization).

rubrics_metrics.name: Training/Volunteer Program Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Volunteer/interpreter/docent related activities: 'Train interpreters, volunteers or docents', 'Create or expand interpreter, docent or volunteer program'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Yes/No variables reported with counts/percents; appear across primary-focus cross-tabs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research, Evaluation & Planning Activities
rubrics_metrics.description: Project activities supporting evaluation or management: 'Support a research and evaluation program, including conducting surveys', 'Develop key management plans', 'Museum outreach activities', 'Other activities (i.e., presentation, publication)'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Reported as Yes/No counts and percents and used as indicators of organizational development components of projects.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Activity Counts (breadth of activities per project)
rubrics_metrics.description: Number of conducted activity types per project categorized as '1 type', '2', '3', '4-6 types'; also summary statistics (Count, Mean, Median, Minimum, Maximum, Total Number Activities).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to summarize the complexity/scope of projects; tables present distribution of projects across these counts and descriptive statistics.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-tab: Primary Focus by Other Activity Areas
rubrics_metrics.description: For projects with a given primary focus (Programming, Exhibitions, Technology, Digitization/Collections), indicator variables showing whether other activity areas were also conducted (Yes/No for each other area).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Tables report number and percent of projects in which multiple areas were conducted to show overlap between focus areas.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Counts and Percentages (n and %)
rubrics_metrics.description: Core reporting metric: number (n=) and percentage (%) of applications/projects for every category and subcategory.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: All tables present counts and percents; percents usually sum to 100% across defined totals; used across discipline, region, size, activity type, award status, and award amount.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statistical Significance Flag
rubrics_metrics.description: Annotation used in tables: '* Statistically significant p≤.05'.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Indicates which comparisons or differences reported in the tables reached statistical significance at p ≤ 0.05.

rubrics_metrics.name: Project Type-Specific Detailed Yes/No Variables
rubrics_metrics.description: Every specific activity listed is captured as a binary variable 'Conducted for the Project: Yes/No' (phrasing repeated across multiple tables e.g., 'Update or create new website Conducted for the Project — Yes/No/Total').
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the standard unit of measurement for activity presence in the report; counts and percentages derived from these binaries are the basis for analyses.

rubrics_metrics.name: Cross-tab: Primary Focus by Museum Size and Award Amount
rubrics_metrics.description: Tables showing the distribution of projects with a given primary focus across museum sizes (Small/Medium/Large) and award amount categories.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Used to examine whether project focus varies by institution size or funding level; reported as n and %.
